name: KiwiCode
description: Cutting-edge software solutions from the heart of New Zealand.
story: KiwiCode is a rapidly growing software company focused on providing innovative solutions for data analysis and performance optimization. As a company founded by motorsport enthusiasts, they see a natural synergy in sponsoring racing teams that rely on data to gain a competitive edge. KiwiCode seeks to enhance its brand recognition globally through motorsport partnerships, showcasing their commitment to precision and performance.
